Name: (ABANDONED) Erasercat's Kotatsus
Author: erasercat
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Hi all!! It's been a few years since I last was in the modding scene due to hostile run ins with other mod makers privately. 
This mod is indefinitely abandoned! I have no desire to update it. Therefore to those who wish to continue using my old mods in newer SDV updates: You have my full permission to unofficially update this mod. All I require is credit for creating it, and that you credit any artists who's assets I used in addition to mine. That's all! 



?[color=#f4cccc]Erasercat's Kotatsus[/color]?[/b][/size]
[color=#ffe599]୨୧[/color][color=#f4cccc] Consider donating to my [url=http://ko-fi.com/erasercat]ko-fi[/url]﻿ if you enjoy my mods! [/color][color=#ffe599]୨୧[/color][/center]
?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Features[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Adds 13 kotatsus to the game.
[*]They can be purchased from Robin for 100 or for free through the furniture catalog. 
[/list]
?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Installation[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Download the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip CF and this mod and drop them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run game using SMAPI!
[/list]
?[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]

[center]Someone beat me to the punch of making a kotatsu mod but I've been
working on this for weeks so I'll be damned if I don't post it lol.﻿
I'll probably add more later on! These are just a starting point.

([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5591]Here's the other kotatsu mod[/url]﻿ if you want to have even more kotatsus in a different style!)[/center]
